A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

, for the first time in stochastic bandit literature, we present an efficient algorithm that does not depend on a prior knowledge of any scale parameter of the noise, but only of a bound on its kurtosis.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the optimal regret is of order O(log(T)) for any kurtosis, which is the same order as the optimal regret for known kurtosis.
